2511-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

4311-5078-5434-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2079-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
2079-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Your life total is even.
6034-6734-8089.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1309-2104-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Salvager of Secrets from exile to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

215-850-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-4785.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3112-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1824-4549-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least 2 cards this turn.
1824-4549-4668.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

5413-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-1671-2638-3129-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2638-3129-4231.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-2438-7195.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

4050-6972-7159.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

3459-5078-6006-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3459-5078-6006-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1879-2366-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1879-2366-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2341-2495-5116.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Gilded Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Gilded Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Gilded Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

338-3490-5070-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-5070-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

625-1978-4667.description:
Cause Elvish Aberration to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4426-4693.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1479-1671-6754.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

215-4050-6251.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
215-4050-6251.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard.
215-4050-6251.description:
Cast Aatchik either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Aatchik enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Insects, adding {4}{B}{B}{G}{G}.
When the Insects die, Aatchik's second ability triggers eight times, putting eight +1/+1 counters on Aatchik and causing each opponent to lose 8 life.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Aatchik from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4050-6251.notes: If you have nine or more artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard, this combo will net infinite tokens, mana and +1/+1 counters on Aatchik.

1753-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
1753-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

618-3742-3967.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

230-853-4871-4875.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has a card in exile.
"Rat" chosen with Conspiracy.
230-853-4871-4875.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Conspiracy, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Scion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1571-3734-4042.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to block creatures you control.
1571-3734-4042.description:
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph's encore ability by paying {3}{U/P} and exiling it, causing you to create a token copy with haste for each opponent you have.
Choose to have each Phyrexian Metamorph token enter the battlefield as a copy of Blightsteel Colossus.
Deal combat damage to each opponent using a Phyrexian Metamorph token, causing each opponent to get eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

687-2335-2387.notablePrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic has a vigilance counter on it.
Barrenton Medic has no -1/-1 counters.
687-2335-2387.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat until Barrenton Medic has four counters on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three -1/-1 counters from Barrenton Medic, causing you to mill three cards and return any permanent with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
